**Question:** What was Cisco's fiscal 2026 total revenue growth YoY and its GAAP net margin (net income / revenue)?
*As of 2026-10-01*

- Cisco's total revenue for FY2026 (fiscal year ended July 25, 2026) was $63,325 million, an increase of 12% compared with fiscal 2025, as reported on a GAAP basis. [1][2][3]
- Calculated from the reported figures, FY2026 total revenue growth over FY2025 was 11.8%. [1][2]
- Cisco's GAAP net income for FY2026 (fiscal year ended July 25, 2026) was $13,267 million, an increase of 30% year over year. [1][2][3]
- Cisco reported FY2026 GAAP net income as a percentage of revenue of 21.0%, up 3.0 percentage points from 18.0% in fiscal 2025. [1]
- Calculated as GAAP net income divided by total revenue, Cisco's FY2026 GAAP net margin was 21.0%. [1][2]

**Sources**
[1] CISCO SYSTEMS, INC. 10-K for FY2026 (filed 2026-09-02) (www.sec.gov, 2026-09-02, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/858877/000085887726000132/csco-20260725.htm
[2] CISCO SYSTEMS, INC. XBRL data tagged in 10-K filed 2026-09-02 (www.sec.gov, 2026-09-02, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/858877/000085887726000132/
[3] CISCO SYSTEMS, INC. earnings release for FY2026, 8-K EX-99.1 (filed 2026-08-12) (www.sec.gov, 2026-08-12, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/858877/000085887726000106/exhibit991pressrelease-q4f.htm

claims.claim: Cisco's total revenue for FY2026 (fiscal year ended July 25, 2026) was $63,325 million, an increase of 12% compared with fiscal 2025, as reported on a GAAP basis.
claims.reason: 10-K FY2026 shows Total revenue 63,325 (in millions) for FY2026 and 56,654 for FY2025, with text stating 'Total revenue was $63.3 billion, an increase of 12% compared with fiscal 2025.' Earnings release also confirms $63.3B revenue, 12% increase. Calculation: (63,325-56,654)/56,654 = 11.78% ≈ 12%.

claims.claim: Calculated from the reported figures, FY2026 total revenue growth over FY2025 was 11.8%.
claims.reason: Using exact figures from 10-K: FY2026 revenue 63,325 million, FY2025 revenue 56,654 million. Growth = (63,325-56,654)/56,654 = 11.775% ≈ 11.8% (rounded to one decimal).

claims.claim: Cisco's GAAP net income for FY2026 (fiscal year ended July 25, 2026) was $13,267 million, an increase of 30% year over year.
claims.reason: 10-K FY2026 shows NET INCOME $13,267 million for FY2026 and $10,180 million for FY2025. Increase = (13,267-10,180)/10,180 = 30.32% ≈ 30%. Earnings release also states $13.3B vs $10.2B, 30% increase.

claims.reason: 10-K FY2026 explicitly states 'Net income as a percentage of revenue | 21.0 | % | 18.0 | % | 3.0 | pts' for FY2026 vs FY2025.
